name: Ore Dake Tsukaeru Tensei Skill [Magical Sword] de Donna Kyonyuu mo Acme Ochi! ~Ore no Kokan no Seiken wa Isekai Bijo Tachi wo Bisho Nure Shouten e to Michibiite Iku~
original_name: 俺だけ使える転生スキル【マジカルソード】でどんな巨乳もアクメ堕ち！～俺の股間の聖剣は異世界美女たちをびしょ濡れ昇天へと導いていく～
source:
The protagonist, Kikutaro Sakamoto, hit his head hard while masturbating in VR and died at the same time as ejaculating.

Alphaigne, a goddess of the heavens, took pity on his pathetic end and proposed reincarnation in another world. As a reincarnation bonus, he could choose one favorite ability from the skill list. And what the virgin Kikutaro chose was...

[Magical Sword].

He was granted the skill on the spot, and immediately tried it out on the goddess! Alphaigne easily fell for him instantly. She decided to accompany him to his reincarnation destination.

However, the moment they descended into the other world, the goddess's power was almost completely lost... Incredibly, she had become a literal "female pig"!

And so, Kikutaro and the (former) goddess begin their journey to reach the city. On the way, they hear sounds of a struggle coming from deep within the forest...
translation:
主角坂本菊太郎在VR中自慰时头部重击，在射精的同时死亡。

天界女神阿尔法涅怜悯他的悲惨结局，提议转世到另一个世界。作为转生奖励，他可以从技能列表中选择一个最喜欢的技能。而处女菊太郎选择的是……

【魔剑】。

他当场就获得了技能，立刻就在女神身上试用了！阿尔法涅立刻就爱上了他。她决定陪他一起前往转世目的地。

然而，当他们降临异世界的那一刻，女神的力量几乎完全丧失……不可思议的是，她变成了名副其实的“母猪”！

于是，菊太郎和（前）女神开始了前往城市的旅程。途中，他们听到森林深处传来打斗的声音……
